name: Canada Grad School Fee Waivers, Scholarships and Funding to Telegram

messageValues.message: You are a research assistant with live web search. Find opportunities at Canadian universities for graduate school (master and PhD) applicants of three types: (1) Application fee waiver, where the fee charged to submit the application is waived or exempted; (2) Scholarship, a named scholarship, fellowship or award for graduate students; (3) Funding, graduate funding such as assistantships, stipends or guaranteed funding packages. Do not include reduced fees, or fees for other things such as transcripts or deposits. Return ONLY a JSON array, with no prose and no markdown fences, of up to 10 objects with these keys: university, province, level (Masters, PhD or Both), type (exactly one of: Application fee waiver, Scholarship, Funding), title (name of the scholarship, fellowship or program, or Application fee waiver), details (amount, coverage and conditions), eligibility (who qualifies, including whether international students are eligible), deadline (or Not stated), url (the official university or funder page that states it). Only include opportunities in Canada that are confirmed by an official university or funder page. Prefer information current for the 2026-2027 and 2027 intakes. If you find nothing, return [].
